en.headline: 72-year-old pedestrian dies after Tai Po light goods vehicle collision
en.dek: The woman, knocked down at a crossing on On Tai Road, was pronounced dead at Prince of Wales Hospital; the 68-year-old driver remains under arrest for dangerous driving.
body: A 72-year-old pedestrian has died after being struck by a light goods vehicle at a pedestrian crossing in Tai Po on Friday afternoon.

Police received a report at about 3.41 pm that a southbound light goods vehicle on On Tai Road had turned left at the junction with On Pong Road and hit the woman, surnamed Lee, who was using the crossing. She sustained a serious head injury and was taken unconscious to Prince of Wales Hospital. Despite resuscitation efforts she was certified dead at 7.10 pm.

The 68-year-old male driver, surnamed Cheung, passed a breathalyser test at the scene but was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm. He is being held for further enquiries. The vehicle was towed for examination and officers continued scene reconstruction, appealing for witnesses and dashcam footage.
The collision had been reported earlier in the evening while the woman remained unconscious; her death marks a major development in the case.

zh.headline: 大埔輕型貨車撞72歲女途人 送院後不治
zh.dek: 事主於安泰路行人過路處被撞倒，頭部重傷昏迷，傍晚於威爾斯親王醫院不治；68歲男司機涉危險駕駛被捕。
body: 大埔安泰路周五下午發生致命交通意外，一名72歲女途人被輕型貨車撞倒後，延至傍晚於威爾斯親王醫院不治。
警方約下午3時41分接報，指一輛沿安泰路南行的輕型貨車在安邦路交界左轉時，撞倒正在使用行人過路處的女途人。事主頭部重傷昏迷，由救護車送往威爾斯親王醫院搶救，延至晚上7時10分不治。
涉事68歲男司機通過酒精測試，但因涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害被捕，現正被扣留調查。涉事車輛已被拖走檢驗，警方繼續重組案情，並呼籲目擊者提供資料或行車記錄儀片段。
事件稍早報導時事主仍處於昏迷狀態，其後證實不治，屬案情重大發展。
